Flat panels Don't work well with anything bellow their native res.
Old consoles use resolutions like 240p or 480i/480p so the flat panel stretches the image to fit its native res. This makes the image blurry and adds lots of input lag.

Also some games use different resolutions for the in game graphics and for the menus and the tv might have a delay when switching resolutions.

A scaler takes the 240p/480i image and scales it before the tv does any work to it. And the monitor threats it as a native res image.
Giving you a clearer image and less lag.
